This occurs when a caller attempts to release the same TempVars instance more than once. The method then proceeds to decrement the stack index and checks if the instance at the top of the stack is 'this'; if not, it throws another exception for out-of-order release. The first throw guards against double-release, which is a programming error violating the usage contract (release exactly once per acquire).
